data.name: Advanced Ascetic Path
data.description: You gain +%1 competence bonus to both AC and saves.  In addition, when using the Ascetic maneuver, you can deflect one attack as if using the Deflect Arrows feat, although you may alternately deflect a melee attack.|AdvancedAsceticPathBonus
prerequisites: PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Ascetic Path ~ First,Ascetic Path ~ Second
